project_title: StokOS ML - Sistema Inteligente de Apoio à Decisão de Estoque
context_strategy: High-density decision-support dashboard designed for small business operators and admins. Emphasizes quick visual scanning of inventory health, statistical ML demand forecasting, actionable replenishment recommendations, role-based access control (Admin vs Operator), and seamless CSV/Excel data operations.

hierarchy.small_label: text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

header_nav.type: Top sticky navigation + secondary breadcrumb bar
header_nav.background: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 z-40
elements: Brand Logo (StokOS ML with signal badge)
Global Search Input (Product SKU, Name, Category)
Role Switcher / User Profile (Admin vs Operador indicator)

layout_architecture.grid_system: MODE B - High Density Bento Grid (gap-4 md:gap-6)

page_structure.title: Visão Geral & Central de Decisão
sections: KPI Summary Strip (Valor Total em Estoque, Itens Críticos, Previsão de Falta 7d, Taxa de Giro)
Decision Banner (AI/ML Recommendations: Recomendações Prioritárias de Compra)
Main Grid (Left 2 cols: Demanda vs Estoque Atual - Chart Recharts; Right 1 col: Alertas Críticos de Reposição)
Stock Health Distribution (Donut Chart & Category Breakdown)
Recent Transactions Ledger (Últimas Entradas e Saídas)

page_structure.title: Catálogo & Cadastro de Produtos
sections: Filter & Search Bar (Category, Status, Stock Level, Search SKU/Name)
Product Table with Status Badges, ML Forecasted Days of Inventory, Minimum Safety Stock, Actions (Editar, Movimentar, Historico)
Product Detail / Edit Modal (Form with Validation: SKU, Nome, Categoria, Preço Custo, Preço Venda, Estoque Mínimo, Ponto de Pedido, Fornecedor)

page_structure.title: Movimentações de Entrada e Saída
sections: Quick Register Movement Card (+ Nova Entrada / - Nova Saída)
Movement History Table (Data, SKU/Produto, Tipo [Entrada/Saída/Ajuste], Quantidade, Motivo, Usuário Operador/Admin)
Filters by Date Range, Type, and User

page_structure.title: Previsão Estatística de Demanda & Recomendação de Compra
sections: ML Prediction Engine Header (Explicabilidade do modelo estatístico simples: Média Móvel Ponderada + Tendência Histórica)
Interactive Forecast Simulator (Ajustar Período: 7, 15, 30 ou 60 dias)
Smart Order Suggestion Table (Produto, Estoque Atual, Demanda Prevista, Sugestão de Compra [Qtd], Custo Estimado, Prioridade [Urgente/Normal/Baixa], Botão 'Gerar Pedido')
Historical vs Predicted Demand Chart for selected product

page_structure.title: Importação & Exportação de Planilhas
sections: Drag & Drop CSV/Excel File Uploader with preview parser
Data Mapping & Validation View (Identify invalid SKUs, missing quantities, errors before commit)
Download Sample Templates (CSV de Produtos, CSV de Movimentações)
Export Data Section (Exportar Estoque Atual, Histórico de Movimentações, Relatório de Previsão em Excel/CSV)

page_structure.title: Gestão de Usuários & Perfis (Admin / Operador)
sections: Current Active Profile Status Banner (Shows permissions for Admin vs Operador)
User List Table (Nome, Email, Perfil [Administrador / Operador], Status, Último Acesso)
Role Capabilities Matrix (Admin: Acesso total, Cadastro, Configuração ML, Importar/Exportar; Operador: Movimentações, Consulta, Registrar Entrada/Saída)

shadcn_primitives: Use Shadcn Dialog/Sheet for Product Form & Movement Drawer
Use Shadcn Select for Category, Movement Type, Role Switcher
Use Shadcn Table with sticky header and crisp borders
Use Shadcn Badge with custom signal color variants
Use Shadcn Tabs for switching between Forecast views and Historical charts
Use Shadcn Tooltip for ML explanation and metric calculations
Use Sonner for toast notifications (e.g. 'Movimentação registrada com sucesso', 'Estoque crítico alertado')

charts.theme: Use semi-transparent fills with high-contrast lines. Tooltip must match dark/light theme with border-border.
types: AreaChart: Demanda Histórica vs Previsão de Vendas (Line 1: Real, Line 2 Dash: Previsão ML)
BarChart: Comparativo por Categoria (Estoque Mínimo vs Estoque Atual)
PieChart/Donut: Distribuição da Saúde do Estoque (Saudável, Baixo, Crítico, Excesso)

testing_attributes.mandatory_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

micro_interactions_and_motion.cards: border rounded-xl bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-xs p-5 hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-slate-700 transition-colors
micro_interactions_and_motion.stagger_entrances: Use lightweight motion opacity/y transitions for table rows and KPI cards

accessibility_guidance.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio on body text and badge text. Ensure alert badges have strong readable text over tinted background.
accessibility_guidance.keyboard_navigation: All table action buttons, search inputs, modal triggers must be accessible via Tab and Enter/Space keys.
accessibility_guidance.screen_reader_labels: Use aria-label on icon-only buttons (e.g. edit, delete, theme-toggle, refresh forecast).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard in Portuguese ('pt-BR') as per the problem statement.

Ensure both 'Administrador' and 'Operador' role modes can be toggled to demonstrate permission restrictions (Operador can view and register movements but cannot delete products or change ML settings).

Provide pre-populated demo data showcasing realistic products (e.g., eletrônicos, vestuário, autopeças, alimentos) with historical stock movements, out-of-stock warnings, and statistical forecast recommendations.
Implement the statistical forecast engine in backend/frontend using weighted moving average + trend factor for demand calculation.
Ensure CSV import has a working parser and preview dialog, and Excel/CSV export triggers a download of sample datasets.
Apply all data-testid attributes specified in testing_attributes.
